name: react-three/postprocessing
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Declarative post effects (bloom, DOF, SSAO, LUTs) for R3F, wrapping postprocessing
summary: pmndrs React wrapper around the postprocessing library: an EffectComposer and effect components (Bloom, DepthOfField, SSAO, Vignette, ToneMapping, LUT and more) placed inside an R3F canvas. Driven by JSX and props; output is the post-processed canvas. Strength is composing effect stacks declaratively in the same tree as the scene.
use_when: Effect stacks in an R3F scene, expressed as JSX next to the meshes
Over raw postprocessing when the scene is already React and R3F
Animating effect props (bloom intensity, focus) from a seekable time value
avoid_when: Non-React Three.js scenes: postprocessing directly, no wrapper
Effects on video or images: FFmpeg or Natron
Custom shader passes with no React: Three.js Shading Language

evidence.result: 90 frames at 1280x720, shuffled order matches sequential, 90 distinct hashes, frame 45 alpha min 0 max 1; postprocessing 6.39.6, three 0.186.1, R3F 9.8.2, Playwright 1.64.1, Chromium 156.0.8078.4.
evidence.scope: R3F EffectComposer, Bloom + ChromaticAberration, seek via flushSync + advance; Bloom leaves alpha haze, not a clean matte; no time-uniform effects (Noise, Glitch); macOS arm64.

assessment.rationale: Released 2026-10-21; tracks R3F and postprocessing. Adds the declarative R3F route to effects that catalogued postprocessing offers only imperatively. Thin wrapper, so value depends on R3F being used.

notes: 2026-10-26: official_url points at the react-postprocessing repo; not independently checked beyond npm metadata.
